Quick question: would you prefer a 30–45 minute intro demo (product tour + Q&A) or a technical deep dive / scoping session so we can get into architecture and POC requirements? I can prepare for either.

If you’d like the latter, we can convert to a 90–120 minute workshop and pull in Monica (Customer Success) for onboarding/rollout planning.

We’ll run this as: 09:00–09:20 goals + architecture overview, 09:20–10:15 latency/cost/quantization deep dive, 10:15–10:30 break, 10:30–11:30 POC scoping (data flow, security, SLAs), 11:30–12:00 open Q&A + next steps.

- If you have an internal test model or a sanitized sample, we can scope a quick micro-benchmark during the session.

I’ve put together a draft agenda and a short "deep-dive workshop" PDF — I’ll attach that to the calendar invite.
